context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 features fully tested. Key endpoints: POST/GET/DELETE /api/general-polls (auth required), GET /api/general-polls/public/{share_token} (public), POST /api/general-polls/public/{share_token}/vote (public), POST /api/general-polls/public/{share_token}/comment (public), POST /api/general-polls/public/{share_token}/add-option (public, when allowed), POST /api/general-polls/{poll_id}/close (auth), GET /api/schedule-polls/{poll_id}/export/csv (auth), GET /api/schedule-polls/{poll_id}/export/pdf (auth), POST /api/schedule-polls/{poll_id}/ai-suggest (auth, requires votes), GET /api/timezones (public). Frontend pages: /schedule (tabs for schedule polls + general polls), /schedule/survey/create (create general poll), /survey/{shareToken} (public voting). AI suggestion uses GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM Key. Email sending is MOCKED.

mocked_apis.email_sending: Email sending is simulated (logged to console) without valid Resend/SendGrid API key

notes: All Phase 3 features are fully functional: (1) General polls support single/multiple/priority voting types, (2) CSV export returns proper CSV with votes matrix and scores, (3) PDF export uses reportlab and generates proper PDF document, (4) AI scheduling suggestion analyzes votes and recommends best time using GPT-5.2, (5) Timezone endpoint returns 20 common timezones. The priority voting correctly uses points-based scoring (highest rank = most points). Custom options can be added to polls when allow_custom_options is enabled. Voting on closed polls is correctly rejected.
